description: Get one discount's full details by id or code (the code match ignores case). Read-only. Returns found: true with id, code, type, value, enabled, currency, minSubtotal (minor units of the default currency, or a fixed code's own), minSubtotalByCurrency (per additional currency), maxUses, currentUses (uses so far), startsAt and endsAt; or { found: false, idOrSlug } when nothing matches. To browse codes, list_discounts; to change one, update_discount.

idOrSlug.description: The discount's id or code (from list_discounts)

name: get_discount
title: Get discount
